name: service
description: A service product (nfdi:NFDI_0000232) is the output of a service process via obo:RO_0002353, and the provider is attached by the service product role rather than by a direct provider link. A separate service specification individual holds what the service promises.
competency_questions: Which services does NFDI-MatWerk offer, and who provides them?; Which service supports a given infrastructure use case?; How is a given service accessed, and by whom is it maintained?
